correctness.rationale: Exact output intersection I<=3 is equivalent to correcting n-4 deletions. Heavy-coordinate assignment bounds heavy words by 3. For n>=10 no light exists; for 7<=n<=9 pairwise light intersections are >=2n-9>=5, so at most one light. At n=6 each light contains one of three four-element receivers, so at most three lights. At n=5 nine explicitly listed incompatible triples cover each of twelve light vectors at least twice, yielding <=4 light, with >=4 pairwise intersection within triples. Explicit witnesses attain upper bounds 7,6,4,3. The bundled checker independently constructs compatibility graphs, validates witnesses and finite certificates at n=5..10, and reproduces VERIFICATION_OK; it is not the proof of the infinite tail.
